name: helm-lhci-runner
description: Pinned Lighthouse CI runner for .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml (audit run-3 ci/lighthouse/npx-unpinned-lhci-range). Kept out of the root lockfile so the app's npm audit stays app-only.
//overrides: R51 (2026-10-27): @lhci/cli 0.15.1 is the newest release and still pulls vulnerable transitive deps. These overrides (each published 7+ days before pinning) clear npm audit: basic-ftp (GHSA-c475-qrg2-pj4r), tmp (GHSA-52f5-9888-hmc6, GHSA-ph9p-34f9-6g65), uuid (GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq), zod (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5), and @puppeteer/browsers 3.x, which drops extract-zip (GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv, GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3; no fixed extract-zip exists). Verified with a real lhci collect + assert run. Drop them when @lhci/cli ships fixed deps.
